channel.title: Thibaut Lefrançois, notes
channel.description: Short notes on web development, shaders and freelance work.

item.title: One design system for the site and everything I make around it
item.description: The site's tokens also draw its Open Graph images, its favicon and the media of every project. What the system leaves alone matters as much as what it covers.

item.title: Bowser Bros: a vertical Mario in C++ and Qt, built in two and a half weeks
item.description: A first-year school game from 2023: four playable versions in two and a half weeks, and the C++ I would write differently today.

item.title: My first GLSL shaders: a 3D carousel that bends and splits around the cursor
item.description: A sine wave in the vertex shader, an RGB split around the cursor in the fragment shader, and the pixel ratio bug that put the split in the wrong place.
